verdict.rationale: Sentry documents an 'Issue Status' triage page, 'Ownership Rules' for assigning owners, and an API to bulk-mutate issues, and its MCP server lists issue triage. These cover assigning and changing issue state, but the evidence is only page titles and short blurbs. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of resolve, ignore and snooze actions, any evidence of automatic reopening when a resolved issue regresses, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
